svg.title: Extra weight lost versus placebo, by drug, on each US label
svg.desc: Percentage points of body weight lost beyond placebo, everyone randomized counted. Without diabetes: Foundayo 17.2 mg 9.0, Wegovy pill 25 mg 11.2, Wegovy shot 2.4 mg 12.4, Zepbound 15 mg 17.8. With type 2 diabetes: Foundayo 7.1, Wegovy shot 6.2, Zepbound 11.6; the Wegovy pill label has no diabetes weight trial. Sources: Foundayo, Wegovy and Zepbound prescribing information.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
